results.title: Perfstaq | Sathvik VK
results.content:
We did not rebuild Perfstaq to make another generate button. There are already excellent tools for producing individual pieces of content. The harder question is what happens before and after generation. Does the system understand the brand? Does it know the campaign goal? Can it turn that goal into a coherent plan? Can it create different formats that still feel connected? Can a human review, reject, or revise the work without losing the thread? That changed how we thought about the product. The unit of work should not be a prompt. It should be a campaign. Perfstaq is being built around that continuity: Brand Brain → campaign plan → coordinated creative → human review. Generation matters. But generation without shared context gives you more pieces to manage. The opportunity is not to [...] AI made content easier. But marketing still feels stitched together. A prompt can give you copy in seconds. An image model can produce a visual. A video tool can create a clip. Then the real work begins. You still have to carry the brand context from tool to tool. You still have to decide what the campaign should say. You still have to make every format feel like it belongs to the same idea. You still have to collect feedback, revise the work, and decide what is actually ready to ship. The bottleneck moved. It did not disappear. For lean marketing teams, the problem is no longer access to generation. It is continuity across the campaign. That is the problem we are building Perfstaq around: one connected path from brand context to campaign plan, coordinated creative, and human review. [...] 18
